positive/.env  error  EG001 missing-variable  CACHE_TTL is declared in positive/.env.example but missing from positive/.env
  variable: CACHE_TTL
  why: Anything that reads CACHE_TTL in the default environment gets no value, which usually fails only at runtime or silently falls back to a default.
  fix: Add `CACHE_TTL=` to positive/.env (it is declared in positive/.env.example:4) and set its value. If it is not needed there, mark it optional in the template (`CACHE_TTL= # optional`) or put `# envguard-ignore EG001` on the line above it in positive/.env.example.
  related: positive/.env.example:4:1
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG001-missing-variable.md
